Start is the agreement. It opens the microphone. The main board does not tick until you press it. Tick is one real cycle. +55 ticks adds fifty-five. 55 Hz keeps that rate, fifty-five real instructions a second, until you press it again.

The microphone is used on this device as a noise floor for the ring. Samples stay in this browser. They are not uploaded. Wipe all data clears what this page stored.

Thirty-three deaths are walked on the screen: eighteen fast rallies, seven stacks, four runs, two digs, two slow streets. The picture breaks. The vortex does not.

The request asks for no echo cancellation, no noise suppression, and no auto gain. After the stream opens, the page reads getSettings and labels the run RAW or PROCESSED. A phone can still filter audio. If it does, the label is PROCESSED.

Temperature is read if the phone has that sensor. If it does not, a slipped clock or CPU pressure raises a heat flag. That flag is not a thermometer.
